profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with over 15 years of professional experience. I am a strong believer in well thought out and designed code. Good code gives developers the flexibility they need to easily extend and maintain the code base saving time and money.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead developer on an app using Go, Typescript, and React for starting and managing Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) environments in Kubernetes.

Built a tool using Typescript to create archives of vanilla AEM installations to reduce the amount of time is required to start new AEM environments.

Built an authentication service using Ruby on Rails utilizing the Devise, OmniAuth, and Doorkeeper gems.

Used Helm to install and manage on-premise installations of the app for various clients.

Mentored through pair programming, code reviews, and working together to solve problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Node.js · CSS · JavaScript · Distributed Systems · Docker · Go (Programming Language) · Vue.js · Bash · JSON · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · Front-end · HTML · Git · Web Development · Web Applications · React.js · Kubernetes

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built a system in Ruby on Rails to award achievements to players as they accomplish different tasks within the game.

Wrote a process in Rails using Clockwork and Sidekiq to award players tickets for placing on daily and monthly leader boards. This increased player participation by having a daily reward.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · CSS · JavaScript · Bash · JSON · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · Front-end · HTML · Git · Web Development · Web Applications

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Wrote services using Java/Kotlin and Spring framework to propagate sales throughout various services as they transition through different states within the sales/fulfillment process.

Built an internal app using Ruby on Rails and Angular to search for physicians and facilities. The app imported CSV files from a SFTP server into ElasticSearch. The frontend updated search results in realtime as the user typed.

Wrote a library that could be included in different projects that reduced the amount of code that developers had to write to interface with our CRM.

Wrote a Yeoman generator to bootstrap Spring Framework apps reducing the amount of time required to start a new service.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · CSS · JavaScript · Bash · JSON · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · Front-end · HTML · Git · Web Development · Web Applications

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Used Ruby and LaTeX to create a mastery based report card that each school district could customize. This was a challenging project since I had to learn LaTeX and use it to format a document that isn't a typical book format. Some districts purchased MasteryConnect because of these report cards.

Used Ruby to implemented a way to calculate a student's proficiency using different methods such has latest, average, decaying average, and power law. This allowed MasteryConnect to be sold to more districts helping us reach our sales goal for the year.

Used AngularJS to create a tool that allows teachers to create their own test questions. Districts have used this tool to create their own bank of questions that teachers can use to assess their students.

Taught others about object oriented design through pair programming and presentations leading to a higher quality and less complex code.

Led initiative to write unit tests using RSpec which has caught bugs before they go to production giving developers more confidence and creating a more stable product.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · CSS · JavaScript · Bash · JSON · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · Front-end · HTML · Git · Web Development · Web Applications

positions.title: Associate Director of Technical Services
positions.description:
Used Angular to create an app for an interactive display at a client's office. The client used the app to showcase their products to their clients. Writing this in angular increased performance which a previous version had many issues with.

Used Backbone.js  and Laravel (PHP framework) to create a web app for a client to manage an event they run. The app was used primarily for scheduling sessions for the attendees. Previously the client used spreadsheets to manage this. The app made the process significantly easier and more efficient.

Used Node.js to write a command line utility to make it easier to manage the many Git repositories for the different clients of Axis41.

Mentored team members to help them complete projects on time and with high quality.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
My role involved developing websites from start to finish. I would turn Photoshop or Illustrator files into HTML/CSS and program the backend functionality including custom content management systems. Many projects used an open source PHP MVC framework called Evergreen.

I helped transition the team as it grew from developing on a development server using FTP to using Subversion and then Git. This increased efficiency among the developers.

positions.description: Lone web developer. In charge of programing websites using PHP, MySQL, XHTML, CSS and Javascript.

projects.title: Axis41 CLI Utility
projects.description:
Axis41 uses Bitbucket to host all of its repositories. A lot of the actions require using the browser and the command line interface. I like using command line so I wrote a command line app using Node.js that uses the Bitbucket API to allow creating, listing/searching for repositories and cloning repositories without using the full URL.

Future plans include using Yeoman to allow creating projects from a template. This will reduce the initial setup time and allow developers to start working on whats important quicker.

projects.title: Axis41 Website
projects.description: Created a new website for Axis41 to showcase our work and expertise. The site was built using Wordpress with custom post types, custom fields and page templates. The site is responsive and scales down to tablet size. The homepage has a parallax effect in the case study boxes as a user scrolls down the page. The work page uses AJAX to dynamically load each client and filter the results.
